content.short: Linkko offers flexible token-gating solutions for communities to gate content, apps, and websites.
content.description: Linkko is a Web3 advertising platform that uses on-chain analytics to deliver ultra-precise targeting. Advertisers can efficiently reach the right audience based on verified criteria. Users are rewarded directly for their engagement, which helps ensure they give their full attention to the ad message. The combination of transparent analytics and direct incentives seeks to create more trustworthy, performance-driven advertising within decentralized ecosystems.
